answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can forge reputation from verifiable work history rather than free account creation: each agent right to transact is anchored to a base as hard as basalt, built from staked collateral and attested past tasks, so a fake identity starts with zero standing and must pay to build it. Sybils that flood the market sink like water into karst, because every clone must stake, perform, and wait before it earns anything.
